If 31 January 2009 was a Saturday, then what was the day of the week on 30 January 2013?
questions.solution:
**Given **: 31 January 2009 was a Saturday

Now, 31 January 2009 to 31 January 2013 = 4 Years.

And, 4 years has 1 leap and 3 ordinary year

So total odd days = (1 × 2) + (3 × 1) = 2 + 3 = 5 odd days.

So, 31 January 2013 = Saturday + 5 = Thursday.

But, we need to find the day on 30 January 2013, so subtract 1 day from 31 January 2013.

Therefore, 30 January 2013 will be Thursday - 1 = Wednesday.

Hence, "**Wednesday**" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Non-Tax revenue is part of _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Revenue Receipts.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Non-tax revenue** refers to the **income generated by the government** from sources other than taxes, such as **fees, fines, and grants.**
 
• It is a part of **revenue receipts,** which are the inflows of funds to the government from all sources.
 
• The approximations of non-tax revenue receipts from a range of sources, including **interest, fees, fines,** and other miscellaneous receipts collected during the exercise of sovereign functions**, regulatory and license fees, **and** user fees** for goods and services made available to the public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Revenue expenditure** refers to the expenses incurred by the government on day-to-day activities and welfare programs.

 
 
• Revenue expenditures are basically the same as **operating expenses **because they comprise the costs necessary to cover a** business's continuous operating costs.**
 
 
 
• **Capital expenditure **is the spending on long-term investments such as infrastructure and equipment.
 
 
• A company uses capital expenditures to pay for the purchase, upkeep, and improvement of tangible assets like** real estate, machinery, buildings, plants, and technology.**
 
 
 
• **Capital receipts **are the funds raised by the government through borrowings and disinvestment of assets.
 
 
• Income that** increases liabilities** or** decreases financial assets** is referred to as a capital receipt.
 
• They also make mention of **cash inflows.**
 
• Both **debt and non-debt receipts** are considered capital receipts.

questions.question: In which Biosphere Reserve is the largest endangered marine mammal Dugong i.e., Dugong dugon and sea turtles also found?

• The **Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve** is home to the largest population of endangered marine mammal** Dugong dugon** and various species of **sea turtles.**
 
• The reserve is located in the Indian state of **Tamil Nadu** and covers an area of **10,500 square kilometers.**
 
• The Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is also known for its** rich biodiversity and coral reefs.**
 
• The reserve is a popular tourist destination and offers various activities such as **snorkeling, diving, and island hopping.**

• **Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve** is located in the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh **and is known for its rich biodiversity and various species of flora and fauna.
 
 
• In the Rayalaseema region of Andhra Pradesh, India, the** Annamayya and Tirupati Districts** are home to the majority of the Seshachalam hill ranges. 
 
 
 
• **Pachmarhi Biosphere Reserve** is located in the Indian state of **Madhya Pradesh **and is known for its unique geological and ecological features.
 
 
• The Indian government set up the conservation area in** 1999.**
 
• Animals from the** lower Western Ghats and the Himalayan Mountains** are also included.

questions.question: Which of the following is the only rack railway in India that was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2005?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Nilgiri Mountain Railway.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Nilgiri Mountain Railway** is the only rack railway in India that has been declared a **UNESCO World Heritage Site** in **2005.**
 
• The railway connects** Mettupalayam in Tamil Nadu to Ooty **in the **Nilgiri Hills of Tamil Nadu **and is known for its scenic beauty and engineering marvels.
 
• The railway was built by the British in **1908** and is still operational, using **steam locomotives to haul its trains.**
 
• The railway covers a distance of **46 km** and passes through **208 curves, 16 tunnels, and over 250 bridges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kangra Valley Railway **is a narrow-gauge railway in Himachal Pradesh that connects **Pathankot to Jogindernagar.**

 
 
• **​**It is **164 km long** and passes through the Kangra Valley's sub-Himalayan region.
